The VA bill this Thursday needs serious changes. I will be signing the discharge petition to bring the Major Richard Star Act to the floor that will ensure it is voted on as a stand alone bill. 

All our veterans who served should be fully eligible for disability pay and we should not be offsetting some disabilities to pay for others. 

We need to find a way where all our veterans are fully taken care of.
